description: Enrichment pipeline for NiFi flow performance - calculates processing efficiency and throughput rates

script.source: if (ctx.processingNanos != null && ctx.invocations != null && ctx.invocations > 0) { ctx.processingEfficiency = (float)(ctx.processingNanos / 1000000000.0 / ctx.invocations); }
if (ctx.queuedCount != null && ctx.queuedSize != null && ctx.queuedSize > 0) { ctx.queueUtilization = (float)(ctx.queuedCount * 100.0 / ctx.queuedSize); }
if (ctx.bytesTransferred != null && ctx.processingNanos != null && ctx.processingNanos > 0) { ctx.throughputRate = (float)(ctx.bytesTransferred * 1000000000.0 / ctx.processingNanos); }
